import sys

def girth(adj, n):
    best = sys.maxsize
    for s in range(n):
        dist = [-1]*n
        parent = [-1]*n
        dist[s] = 0
        q = [s]
        idx = 0
        while idx < len(q):
            u = q[idx]
            idx += 1
            for v in adj[u]:
                if dist[v] == -1:
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                    parent[v] = u
                    q.append(v)
                elif parent[u] != v and parent[v] != u:
                    # found a cycle
                    cycle_len = dist[u] + dist[v] + 1
                    if cycle_len < best:
                        best = cycle_len
    return best if best != sys.maxsize else -1
